what_its_for: Istradefylline is used to help adults with Parkinson's disease who are already taking levodopa/carbidopa. It helps reduce 'off' periods — times when your Parkinson's symptoms like tremors, stiffness, and slow movement come back or get worse because your levodopa medication is not working as well.
how_to_take: Take istradefylline by mouth once a day, with or without food. Swallow the tablet whole. Try to take it at the same time every day to help you remember. Do not crush, chew, or split the tablet unless your doctor or pharmacist tells you it is okay.
dosing: The usual starting dose is 20 mg once daily. Your doctor may increase your dose to 40 mg once daily if needed. Always take the dose your doctor prescribed. Do not change your dose on your own.
missed_dose: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember — but only if it is still the same day. If it is already the next day, skip the missed dose and take your next dose at your regular time. Never take two doses in one day to make up for a missed one.
storage: Store istradefylline at room temperature, between 68°F and 77°F (20°C and 25°C). Keep it in the original container with the lid tightly closed. Store it away from heat, moisture, and direct light. Keep all medications out of reach of children and pets.
what_to_avoid: Avoid smoking or using tobacco products while taking this medication, as smoking can make the drug less effective. Avoid drinking large amounts of grapefruit juice, as it may increase the amount of this drug in your body and raise the risk of side effects. Avoid driving or operating heavy machinery until you know how this medication affects you, since it can cause sudden sleepiness or dizziness. Tell your doctor about all other medications you take, as some drugs can interact with istradefylline.
when_to_call_doctor: Call your doctor right away if you experience: sudden, strong urges you cannot control (such as gambling, eating, spending money, or sexual urges); unusual movements or twitching (dyskinesia) that are new or get worse; hallucinations (seeing or hearing things that are not there); confusion or unusual behavior; severe dizziness or fainting; or any other side effects that worry you. Seek emergency help if you experience a high fever, muscle stiffness, or confusion, as these may be signs of a serious condition.
when_it_works: You may start to notice improvement in your 'off' periods within the first few weeks of treatment. However, it may take up to 4 to 12 weeks to feel the full benefit. Keep taking your medication as directed even if you do not notice changes right away. Do not stop taking it without talking to your doctor first.
special_populations: Older adults (age 65 and over): Use with caution, as older patients may be more sensitive to side effects like hallucinations and dizziness. Liver problems: If you have moderate liver disease, your doctor may limit your dose to 20 mg per day. This medication is NOT recommended if you have severe liver disease. Pregnancy and breastfeeding: Tell your doctor if you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding. The safety of this medication during pregnancy and breastfeeding is not fully known. Children: This medication is only approved for adults and should not be used in children.
